skill.summary: Cloud-based ai-powered-video-editor tool that handles automatically editing raw footage into shareable videos. Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files (up to 500MB)...

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-powered-video-editor 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI-powered, cloud-based video editor for automatic editing and export of polished content.
- Supports upload of raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and outputs 1080p MP4 in 1-2 minutes.
- Session setup and free token generation included for seamless onboarding.
- Offers keyword-based actions for editing, exporting, checking credits, uploading, and timeline status.
- Handles common video formats, enforces attribution headers, and provides detailed error feedback for smooth workflow.
